verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents automatic prompt caching that works on all supported API requests with no code changes or manual breakpoints. Cached tokens also don't count toward the uncached TPM limit, so a higher cache hit rate lets users process far more total tokens. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of latency (TTFT) reduction or per-token cost discounts for cached tokens, a list of supported models and cache behavior details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
